page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.8xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance based on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs backed by 16 physical AMD EPYC 9T24 cores running at 2.7 GHz with simultaneous multithreading (2.0 threads per core). The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The processor hardware incorporates 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512 (including AVX512_VNNI and AVX512_BF16), AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The server includes no local disk storage and no GPU hardware.

Performance benchmark results show strong single-core compute performance, highlighted by a stress-ng single-core score of 3072.08 and a Geekbench single-core score of 2002.0. Memory performance metrics reflect a PassMark memory score of 2845.24, with large block uncached read bandwidth reaching 76.99 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 55.81 GB/sec. Dedicated multi-core metrics sit in average performance tiers, including a stress-ng multi-core result of 49187.43, a Geekbench multi-core score of 16430.0, and a software compilation score of 32984.0. The hardware demonstrates strong result tiers in Geekbench text processing (2628.0), image processing (14365.0), and PassMark CPU encryption tests (38480.15).

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM profile and lack of local storage prioritize CPU compute density over large memory footprints or ephemeral disk IOPS. Qualitative resource efficiency is aligned with compute-focused workloads reliant on external volume storage. Appropriate workload fits include single-thread sensitive application tiers, software build compilation, cryptographic payload handling, text processing tasks, and static web serving.
